feedback: Justin's confession follows directly from the source contradiction available before voting. It confirms the poison-taking and glass contamination actions, but those actions complete an already supported mechanism rather than introducing a missing decisive fact. His explanation of wanting his history remembered connects credibly to the threatened property story and his earlier admission about turning records into a story. The last line about the folder surviving him gives the confession a specific emotional consequence. Barb's badge and protection of catering staff make her alternative ending feel consequential; Hugh's concession is similarly distinct. The solution feels earned, with slightly less uncertainty because Justin's final claim was so conspicuously at odds with the retained clipping.
